outcome.goal: Speed up the report page without changing its output.
outcome.deliverable: The optimised page and before/after timings from the same machine.

facts.text: The page currently renders in about 4 seconds on the test laptop.

criteria.text: Render the page with the same filters before and after; the HTML is identical.
Time three renders before and after; the median is lower.
Note any case where correctness and speed were traded.

requirements.text: Keep the query logic in the existing repository module.
requirements.rationale: the module is shared with the export feature, so a second copy of the query would drift.

requirements.text: Do not change the report's column set or ordering.
Cached totals may be up to 5 minutes stale.
requirements.rationale: the user chose freshness over an extra database round trip.

authorized.text: profiling and changing the report page and its queries.
